title: Paste the brief
body: Forward the email, drop in the Slack thread, or type three lines from the discovery call. Pilot reads messy — half sentences, a budget that moves, and "we'll figure that bit out later" all parse fine.

title: Check the numbers
body: Pilot comes back with scope, three packages, and a schedule. You correct what it got wrong — usually one line item and a rate — and everything downstream re-prices itself.
meta: Two minutes, most of it reading

title: Send it while they're warm
body: Export a branded PDF, share a link that tells you the moment it's opened, or push it straight into your contract tool. The follow-ups queue themselves for day three and day eight.
